app_identity.name: Souvera Central
app_identity.core_directive: Strictly utilize Nextcloud CSS variables and Souvera design tokens. No hardcoded colors. Exploit full screen width.

design_principles: Full Screen Tension: Break out of the 800px/1400px centered constraints. Data-heavy admin interfaces breathe best when spread across the entire viewport using flexible CSS Grids.
Native Integration: UI must feel like an organic extension of Nextcloud v34. This means exclusively relying on Nextcloud's CSS variable engine for colors and radii.
Information Density over Whitespace: Administrative dashboards require high density. We achieve clarity through structural borders and subtle background shifts, not excessive padding.
Bento Grids for Actions: Replace vertical button lists with structured action cards that provide context and clear visual hierarchy.

layout_strategy.full_width_execution: Remove 'max-width' limits on '.app-content' wrappers. Implement a master grid wrapper: 'display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(480px, 1fr)); gap: 32px; padding: 32px;'. This ensures forms use the whole screen dynamically. On ultra-wide monitors, sections stack in masonry or multi-column grids rather than stretching inputs to unreadable lengths.

group_management.layout: A CSS Grid with two equal columns ('1fr 1fr') on large screens, stacking on mobile. Left Pane: 'Member of', Right Pane: 'Administrator of'.
group_management.ui_pattern: Replace clunky collapsibles with solid panels. Panel background: 'var(--color-main-background)', border: '1px solid var(--color-border)', border-radius: 'var(--border-radius-large)'.
group_management.interaction: Top of each pane contains a search/dropdown. Selected groups appear immediately below as a dense cluster of chips.
group_management.chip_design: Background: 'var(--color-background-dark)', border-radius: 'var(--border-radius-pill)', padding: '4px 12px'. Hovering shows a distinct remove icon.

alias_management.concept: Alias Control Hub with Visual Quota
alias_management.layout: Full-width dashboard layout. Header row contains Quota visualization, followed by the Alias Table/List, ending with the 'Add Alias' control row.
alias_management.quota_ui: Horizontal progress track. Track background: 'var(--color-background-dark)'. Fill: 'var(--color-primary-element)'. If >= 80%: 'var(--color-warning)'. If >= 100%: 'var(--color-error)'. Limit selector sits inline.
alias_management.list_ui: Rows separated by 'border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border)'. Primary alias has a visual badge (Background: 'var(--color-success)', color: 'var(--color-main-background)', border-radius: 'var(--border-radius-pill)').
alias_management.add_form: Grid alignment: '[Localpart Input: 2fr] @ [Domain Select: 1.5fr] [Add Button: auto]'. Height enforced by 'var(--sc-control-height)'.

advanced_actions_danger_zone.layout: Replace the vertical list with a flexible grid: 'grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 16px;'.
advanced_actions_danger_zone.card_ui: Action Cards: 'border: 1px solid var(--color-border)', 'border-radius: var(--border-radius-large)', 'padding: 24px', 'background: var(--color-main-background)', 'transition: all 0.2s ease'. Each card contains a prominent Icon, bold Title, and a muted descriptive Subtitle.
advanced_actions_danger_zone.hover_states: Standard Cards: Hover shifts background to 'var(--color-background-hover)'. Destructive Cards (Wipe/Delete): Hover shifts border to 'var(--color-error)'.

testing_requirements.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., 'data-testid="user-editor-save-button"').
